block.name: Dashboard
block.purpose: Structure for an overview: a header, a row of three or four KPIs, then a wide and a narrow panel.
block.description: A PageHeader, a KPI row on the 12-column grid (four on col-span-3 or three on col-span-4) with tabular numerals, a delta and its sentiment, then a col-span-8 primary panel and a col-span-4 secondary panel. KPIs are typed data so every figure renders the same way. Renders the main area only.
whenToUse: The landing page of a product area: billing, treasury, payouts.
A few headline figures followed by what needs attention.
whenNotToUse: More than four KPIs: split the page or move figures into a panel.
A single record or a long list: use the record or list template.
rules: Render inside AppShell's main; never add a second main or a TopBar.
The PageHeader title is the page's only h1; panel titles are h2.
Three or four KPIs; every value is Text numeric.
A delta's sentiment says whether it is good news; up is not always positive.
At most one primary Button, in the PageHeader actions.
